name: Arrow Greentech Limited
tagline: Small-cap water-soluble/biodegradable-film manufacturer (Watersol brand) and patent-royalty holding company with strong margins and an almost debt-free balance sheet, riding a genuine anti-single-use-plastic tailwind - but conflicting fundamentals data and a respected ValuePickr veteran's explicit 'very large loss... hope investment' account temper conviction. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@saditya10p, bullish, high conviction).
business_overview: Arrow Greentech (BSE: 516064) is a holding company built around cast water-soluble film manufacturing and patent/royalty income, marketed under the Watersol brand for biodegradable and bio-compostable packaging (used in agrochemicals, detergent pods, embroidery/textile transfer film etc.), plus a Hightech Products segment (lamination films, holograms). It describes itself as India's largest water-soluble-film manufacturer. Green Products segment revenue grew ~52% YoY to ~Rs 36.9 Cr in FY26.

Rs 47 Cr (-25% YoY) -- Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 27 Cr, +151% YoY
-12%(FY22) -> 21%(FY23) -> 35%(FY24) -> 53%(FY25 peak) -> 30%(FY26) -- the earlier '2.79%' figure was a bad scrape, now discarded
~21% last year; ~28% 3-yr avg; ~14% 10-yr avg (drags in the loss-making FY18-22 years) -- the earlier '14.2%/23.16%' conflict is resolved as different averaging windows, not a real discrepancy
Almost debt-free (~Rs 2 Cr borrowings); promoter (Shilpan Patel) filed zero-encumbrance declaration for FY26 -- no pledge
27 patents to date, including two newly granted in 2026 (dual colour-shift security film; multicolour security fibres/planchettes) -- exclusive 20-yr protection
fundamentals_narrative: This pass reconciles the prior 'conflicting data' caveat using screener.in's own fiscal-year-labelled tables (the earlier scrape mixed calendar-year and FY conventions): ROCE moved -12% (FY22, COVID-hit) -> 21% -> 35% -> a 53% peak (FY25) -> 30% (FY26); ROE sits at ~21% last year vs a ~14% 10-year average dragged down by the FY18-22 loss years -- both prior 'conflicting' figures turn out to be different, individually correct, averaging windows, not a real data problem. The genuinely new finding this pass: FY26 was a real down year (revenue -17.6%, PAT -25% YoY, Q4 FY26 particularly weak at -27% YoY) that the original write-up's smooth '52% YoY Green Products growth' framing did not surface -- followed by a sharp Q1 FY27 rebound (+111% revenue, +151% PAT YoY, highest-ever quarter), making this a genuinely lumpy, order-driven business rather than a steady compounder. Also newly confirmed: the company's core moat is patent-protected security/anti-counterfeiting film technology (27 patents, including two freshly granted in 2026) more than the 'anti-single-use-plastic' packaging narrative the original write-up emphasised -- Green Products (the biodegradable-packaging segment) was ~18% of FY26 revenue, growing fast off a small base, while Hightech (security films, holograms) remains the larger earner. A forum search still surfaces a long-time, well-regarded ValuePickr member (dd1474, two posts with 34-35 likes) explicitly describing Arrow Greentech as 'one such hope investment for which I booked very large loss in my investment career' -- a real, credible bear signal, though from 2022 and pre-dating the FY24-27 patent grants and margin/ROCE strength.
